# Quickstart — Hello World

Get Agent Smith running in under 2 minutes. This guide walks you through installing the CLI, configuring your backend, and running your first query.

## Prerequisites

You'll need:

- **Node.js and npm** installed ([install guide](https://nodejs.org))
- **A language model backend** running
  - [Llama.cpp](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp)
  - Or any OpenAI-compatible API

## Step 1 of 3: Install the CLI

<div style="background: #f0f7ff; border-left: 4px solid #0066cc; padding: 12px 16px; margin: 16px 0; border-radius: 4px;">
<strong>Step 1 of 3 — Install the CLI</strong><br>
<div style="background: #e0e0e0; border-radius: 4px; height: 8px; margin-top: 8px;">
<div style="background: #0066cc; width: 33%; height: 100%; border-radius: 4px;"></div>
</div>
<span style="font-size: 12px; color: #666; margin-top: 4px; display: inline-block;">Current step: Install the CLI</span>
</div>

Install the Agent Smith terminal client globally:

```bash
npm i -g @agent-smith/cli
```

A global `lm` command is available once installed.

## Step 2 of 3: Configure Your Backend

<div style="background: #f0f7ff; border-left: 4px solid #0066cc; padding: 12px 16px; margin: 16px 0; border-radius: 4px;">
<strong>Step 2 of 3 — Configure Your Backend</strong><br>
<div style="background: #e0e0e0; border-radius: 4px; height: 8px; margin-top: 8px;">
<div style="background: #0066cc; width: 66%; height: 100%; border-radius: 4px;"></div>
</div>
<span style="font-size: 12px; color: #666; margin-top: 4px; display: inline-block;">Current step: Configure your backend</span>
</div>

Create a config file at `~/.config/agent-smith/config.yml`:

```yaml
# ~/.config/agent-smith/config.yml
backends:
  default: "ollama"
  ollama:
    type: "openai"
    url: "http://localhost:11434/v1"
```

> **Tip**: If you're using a different backend, adjust the `url` and `apiKey` accordingly. See <a href="javascript:openLink('/terminal_client/config')">Configuration</a> for all options.

Sync the config into the database:

```bash
lm conf
```

## Step 3 of 3: Run Your First Query

<div style="background: #f0f7ff; border-left: 4px solid #0066cc; padding: 12px 16px; margin: 16px 0; border-radius: 4px;">
<strong>Step 3 of 3 — Run Your First Query</strong><br>
<div style="background: #e0e0e0; border-radius: 4px; height: 8px; margin-top: 8px;">
<div style="background: #0066cc; width: 100%; height: 100%; border-radius: 4px;"></div>
</div>
<span style="font-size: 12px; color: #666; margin-top: 4px; display: inline-block;">Current step: Run your first query</span>
</div>

Run a simple query to verify everything is working:

```bash
lm q "Say hello in three words"
```

If you see a response, your backend is connected and ready! ✨

> ⚠️ **Troubleshooting**: If you get a connection error, make sure your backend is running. For Ollama, run `ollama list` to verify a model is pulled.
